RDKit MinimalLib offline runtime
npm package: @rdkit/rdkit@2026.3.6 (reported RDKit version 2026.03.6)

Source URLs (the unversioned app URLs resolved to these exact URLs):
https://unpkg.com/@rdkit/rdkit@2026.3.6/dist/RDKit_minimal.js
https://unpkg.com/@rdkit/rdkit@2026.3.6/dist/RDKit_minimal.wasm

License: BSD 3-Clause, included in LICENSE.
The runtime is loaded from this directory in the web build and embedded in the
single HTML file for the portable build. No CDN access occurs at runtime.
